title: 高处作业与坠落防护
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/141_高处作业与坠落防护.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/141_高处作业与坠落防护/src.py

points.K6: 首选：能不登高就不登高

shots.scene: 欣欣系着全身式安全带站在护栏后
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a full body safety harness and stands behind a guardrail on a rooftop, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第12章第四课：高处作业与坠落防护。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着下方，竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points down over the guardrail and raises one finger in warning.
shots.narration: 坠落，是施工维修中最常见的致命事故。

shots.scene: 实验楼屋顶，工人要检修排风机
shots.prompt_en: On the flat roof of a laboratory building, a worker walks toward an exhaust fan near the roof edge.
shots.narration: 实验楼屋顶，工人要检修排风机。

shots.scene: 屋顶边没有护栏，工人没系安全带
shots.prompt_en: The roof edge has no guardrail and the worker wears no harness, tools hanging loosely from his belt.
shots.narration: 屋边没护栏，他也没系安全带。

shots.scene: 楼下学生正从门口经过
shots.prompt_en: Below the building, the young male student walks past the entrance under the roof edge.
shots.narration: 楼下，阿杰正从门口经过。

shots.scene: 老李在屋顶入口拦住工人
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stops the worker at the roof access door, raising a hand.
shots.narration: 老李：先停下，防护还没做！

shots.scene: 人站在高处，下方标出坠落基准面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker on a platform with a dashed line marking the lowest point he could fall to. No text.
shots.narration: 在可能坠落的高处作业，叫高处作业。

shots.scene: 高度标尺，两米处有标记
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a height ruler beside a platform with a marker at two meters above the fall reference line. No text.
shots.narration: 国家标准：坠落基准面两米及以上。

shots.scene: 掉进楼板孔洞也算
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person near an open floor hole, an arrow showing a fall into the hole. No text.
shots.narration: 可能掉进孔洞、开口的，也要防护。

shots.scene: 高度越高、风险越多，分级越高
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a staircase of levels getting taller with more warning icons on each step. No text.
shots.narration: 按高度和危险因素分级，级别越高越严。

shots.scene: 国外数值打叉，国家标准书打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a foreign ruler crossed out and a national standard book with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 高度界限按国家标准，不照搬国外。

shots.scene: 人从高处坠落
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker silhouette falling from a roof edge, a red warning. No text.
shots.narration: 人会坠落：临边、洞口最危险。

shots.scene: 老化的梯子、松动的平台
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cracked ladder and a loose platform board, each with a warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 设备会失效：梯子坏、平台松。

shots.scene: 大风、雨雪、雷电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three weather icons, strong wind, rain and snow, and lightning. No text.
shots.narration: 天气会添乱：风雨雷电，停止登高。

shots.scene: 工具从高处掉下砸到人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wrench falling from a height toward a person below. No text.
shots.narration: 东西掉下去，还会砸伤下面的人。

shots.scene: 易碎采光板屋面，脚踩上去裂开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a foot stepping on a fragile skylight panel on a roof, cracks spreading. No text.
shots.narration: 采光板、石棉瓦，一踩就可能塌。

shots.scene: 屋面挂警示标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a warning sign posted at the edge of a fragile roof area. No text.
shots.narration: 先挂警示，提醒别踩上去。

shots.scene: 铺爬板分散重量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: crawling boards laid across the fragile roof, a worker on the boards with weight spread out. No text.
shots.narration: 铺爬板分散重量，人走爬板上。

shots.scene: 心脏、癫痫、恐高图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a heart problem, a seizure and fear of heights next to a ladder, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 心脏病、癫痫、恐高等，不安排登高。

shots.scene: 头晕、疲劳、饮酒、吃药
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of dizziness, a tired face, a wine glass and a sleepy pill, each crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 头晕疲劳、饮酒服药，不要登高。

shots.scene: 没有防护的人被拦下
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker without a harness stopped at the bottom of a ladder by a stop hand. No text.
shots.narration: 没有坠落防护，同样不能上。

shots.scene: 高处作业审批表盖章
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank work at height permit receiving a stamp. No text.
shots.narration: 高处作业，按规定先审批。

shots.scene: 架子工、电工出示操作证
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a scaffold worker and an electrician each holding a blank operator certificate card. No text.
shots.narration: 登高架设等特种作业，必须持证。

shots.scene: 安全生产法的书
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed law book beside a guardrail icon and a harness icon. No text.
shots.narration: 安全生产法：高处作业要有防护。

shots.section_title: 首选：能不登高就不登高
shots.scene: 三层金字塔：避免、护栏、安全带
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pyramid with three levels, avoid working at height on top, guardrails in the middle, a harness at the bottom. No text.
shots.narration: 防坠落的顺序：避免、护栏、个人防护。
overlay: 首选：能不登高就不登高

shots.section_title: 首选：能不登高就不登高
shots.scene: 用长杆在地面清洁高处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker on the ground using a long pole tool to reach a high light fitting. No text.
shots.narration: 能用长杆在地面做的，就不上去。

shots.section_title: 首选：能不登高就不登高
shots.scene: 把设备降下来维修
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lamp lowered on a winch to the floor for repair. No text.
shots.narration: 能把设备降下来修的，就降下来。

shots.section_title: 首选：能不登高就不登高
shots.scene: 防坠落计划：首要是不掉下来
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank fall protection plan with a shield icon stopping a fall. No text.
shots.narration: 防坠落计划，首要是不让人掉下来。

shots.scene: 护栏：顶栏、中栏、挡脚板、立柱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a guardrail with a top rail, a mid rail, a toe board and posts, each part highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 护栏：顶栏、中栏、挡脚板。

shots.scene: 护栏一次保护所有人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several workers on a roof all protected by one guardrail, a tick above. No text.
shots.narration: 护栏一次保护所有人，优先于安全带。

shots.scene: 太低的护栏挡不住人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a very low rail with a person tipping over it, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 护栏高度有规定，太低挡不住人。

shots.scene: 挡脚板挡住滚落的工具
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a toe board stopping a rolling tool from falling off the edge. No text.
shots.narration: 挡脚板挡住物料，也防人滑出去。

shots.scene: 楼板开口用硬盖板固定，挂警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a floor opening covered with a fixed rigid cover and a warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 洞口要硬隔离、盖牢，挂警示。

shots.scene: 一根彩带拦洞口，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single plastic tape across a floor opening, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 一根彩带，挡不住人。

shots.scene: 盖板挪开时有人看守
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cover lifted from an opening, a guard standing beside it with barriers around. No text.
shots.narration: 盖板挪开，要有人看守、设围挡。

shots.scene: 沟盖缺失，学生报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a missing drain cover on a campus path, a student calling to report it. No text.
shots.narration: 发现开口、沟盖缺失，立即报告。

shots.scene: 工具系绳，装进工具袋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hammer tied to a wrist with a lanyard and small tools in a closed tool bag. No text.
shots.narration: 工具系绳，用工具袋装。

shots.scene: 松散材料固定好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: loose boards on a platform tied down with straps. No text.
shots.narration: 松散材料，固定好再干活。

shots.scene: 下方拉警戒，学生绕行
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a barrier and warning sign below a work at height area, a student walking around it. No text.
shots.narration: 下方拉警戒，学生绕行不穿过。

shots.scene: 全身式安全带，带子包住肩、胸、腿
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a full body harness with straps over the shoulders, chest and thighs, a back attachment ring. No text.
shots.narration: 登高专用：全身式安全带。

shots.scene: 安全带、连接件、挂点三部分
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a harness, a lanyard with an energy absorber and an anchor point linked in a chain. No text.
shots.narration: 安全带、连接件、挂点，缺一不可。

shots.scene: 坠落时安全带拉住人，冲击力分散
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker caught by a harness in a fall, force arrows spreading across the straps. No text.
shots.narration: 一旦失足，把人拉住，分散冲击。

shots.scene: 三种用途的安全带图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three harness types, one for pole work, one for restraint and one for fall arrest. No text.
shots.narration: 安全带分几类，按用途选用。

shots.scene: 系了安全带但挂在不牢的管子上，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lanyard hooked onto a thin loose pipe, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 系了安全带，挂点不牢也白搭。

shots.scene: 挂点在头顶上方，高挂低用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lanyard hooked to an anchor above the worker's head, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 挂点高于腰部，高挂低用。

shots.scene: 挂在脚下的打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lanyard hooked to a point near the worker's feet, a long fall arrow, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 低挂高用，坠落距离长、冲击大。

shots.scene: 【实拍】穿好安全带后收紧腿带和胸带（中景）
shots.prompt_en: Medium shot: a person in a full body harness tightening the leg straps and the chest strap.
shots.narration: 胸带腿带收紧，调到贴身。

shots.scene: 松垮的安全带打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a loose harness hanging off a body, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 松松垮垮，等于没穿。

shots.scene: 坠落制动：坠落时接住人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fall arrest system catching a worker in mid air, a lanyard with an energy absorber extended. No text.
shots.narration: 坠落制动系统，万一坠落把人接住。

shots.scene: 下方要留够净空，不撞到地面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fall distance arrow ending above the ground with clear space left below. No text.
shots.narration: 挂点要高，下方留够净空。

shots.scene: 屋顶上的水平生命线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a horizontal steel lifeline along a roof with a worker's lanyard sliding on it. No text.
shots.narration: 没有锚点，就设生命线挂安全带。

shots.scene: 人拉着人打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one worker holding another worker's lanyard by hand, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不能让人拉着，生命线由专业人员设。

shots.scene: 用前检查：织带、缝线、带扣
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a harness laid out with magnifier icons on the webbing, stitching and buckles. No text.
shots.narration: 防坠装备，每次用前都要查。

shots.scene: 【实拍】双手逐段弯折检查安全带织带和缝线（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands bending a harness webbing section by section and checking the stitching.
shots.narration: 织带有无磨损、割口，缝线是否开线。

shots.scene: 【实拍】检查挂钩锁门开合灵活、能自动关闭（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands opening and releasing the gate of a lanyard connector to check it closes and locks by itself.
shots.narration: 挂钩开合灵活，锁门能自动关上。

shots.scene: 受过冲击、损坏的安全带剪断报废
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a damaged harness with a cut mark and a scissors icon, sent to a scrap bin. No text.
shots.narration: 坠落冲击过、损坏的，立即报废。

shots.scene: 定期检验，按标准和说明书
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a calendar and a product manual beside a harness with a check tag. No text.
shots.narration: 按标准和说明书定期检验，先受培训。

shots.scene: 人挂在安全带上，腿带勒住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker hanging in a harness after a fall, the leg straps pressing on the thighs. No text.
shots.narration: 被安全带挂住后，也不能久挂。

shots.scene: 腿部血流受阻示意
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a leg with blood flow arrows slowing under a tight strap, a warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 腿带勒住血管，久挂会严重受伤。

shots.scene: 展开缓解带踩住
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hanging worker unfolding a relief strap loop and standing in it. No text.
shots.narration: 缓解带：展开踩住，减轻腿部受压。

shots.scene: 救援预案和救援器材
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank rescue plan, a rescue pole and a descent device ready near a roof. No text.
shots.narration: 救援计划，是为了尽快把人救下。

shots.scene: 按预案把悬挂的人救下来
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: trained rescuers lowering a hanging worker to the ground with a rescue device. No text.
shots.narration: 挂着的人，按预案尽快救下。

shots.scene: 有人摔下，不随便搬动，打120
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fallen person on the ground, a hand stopping others from moving him, a phone with 120. No text.
shots.narration: 有人摔下，先别搬动，马上打120。

shots.scene: 报告实验室负责人和保卫处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: arrows from the scene to the lab supervisor and the campus security office. No text.
shots.narration: 同时报告负责人和保卫处。

shots.scene: 实验室高柜和仪器平台
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student looks up at a tall reagent cabinet and an instrument platform in the lab.
shots.narration: 实验室里也有高处：高柜、平台。

shots.scene: 站在转椅、纸箱上打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person standing on a rolling office chair and a cardboard box to reach a shelf, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不站转椅、纸箱、实验凳够东西。

shots.scene: 【实拍】小研用合格踏凳取高柜上的空盒子（全景）
shots.prompt_en: Wide shot: a student steps onto a sturdy two step stool on a level floor and takes an empty box from a high shelf.
shots.narration: 用合格的踏凳或人字梯。

shots.scene: 空手爬梯，重物另行传递
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person climbing a ladder with both hands free, a box passed up separately with a rope, a person carrying a box up a ladder crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别扛着重物爬梯，空手三点接触。

shots.scene: 金字塔：避免、护栏、安全带
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a three level pyramid, avoid, guardrail, harness. No text.
shots.narration: 能不登高就不登，护栏优先。

shots.scene: 安全带高挂、用前检查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a harness hooked high and a magnifier on webbing. No text.
shots.narration: 全身式安全带，高挂低用，用前必查。

shots.scene: 挡脚板、救援
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two icons, a toe board with a tool and a rescue tripod. No text.
shots.narration: 防物料坠落，悬挂的人尽快救。

shots.scene: 欣欣扶着一架人字梯挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a stepladder with one hand and waves goodbye with the other.
shots.narration: 下一课：梯子与脚手架。
